title: Luna Japanese → English retest

pricing.method: Apply published Standard USD rates per million tokens to the observed CLI usage across all attempts. Ordinary input = total input minus cached reads minus cache writes. Output already includes reasoning; image input is already included in input usage. Neither is charged twice. No-cache sensitivity prices all input as ordinary input with caching disabled.
pricing.limitations: Counterfactual API-equivalent token cost, not an API bill or a Codex subscription charge. Includes Codex instructions and tool-loop context; a lean API translator may cost less. Excludes grading, local compute, taxes, regional uplifts and separately charged hosted tools. Requested model rates are used because backend routing is not independently observable. Missing delegated usage or request-level long-context detail is labeled as a lower bound and excluded from value recommendations. Cache reuse in production can differ. Captures may contain two printed pages; cost per 100 captures is an extrapolation, not per 100 printed pages.

methodology: Same original PNG bytes and translation prompt as the September benchmark. Five reasoning levels; fresh ephemeral CLI sessions; three translation workers.

Both original and fresh translations regraded anonymously by Astra High and Sol High. Each effort pair shares a review batch. Two batches of six and four candidates per source; randomized pair allocation and independent judge ordering.
Historical scores shown separately from fresh paired grades. Score weights: accuracy 50%, completeness 25%, names/numbers 15%, fluency 10%. Usable means both judges marked it usable.
95% paired bootstrap intervals resample the 12 captures (10,000 replicates, seed 20261004). They describe this sample, not population accuracy; captures from one series are not independent books.
The September 25 image-encoding fix motivated this retest. Timing and changes in model, CLI, context, and judges prevent attributing any change specifically to that fix.

API-equivalent costs include observed CLI context and reasoning output across attempts. These are not actual bills. Grading costs excluded. Requested models/settings are recorded; hidden backend routing is not independently observable.
Only numeric results, hashes, and methods are public. Source images, translations, review excerpts, and local account details remain private.
